# Import necessary modules
	import time

	# Define the tag path [default]_02MOT0101/RS
	TagName = self.view.params.TagName
	tagPath = "[default]{}/LRST".format(TagName)
	
	# Function to activate the tag
	def activateTag():
	    # Write the value to the tag to activate it
	    system.tag.writeBlocking([tagPath], [True])
	    print("Tag activated.")
	
	# Function to deactivate the tag
	def deactivateTag():
	    # Write the value to the tag to deactivate it
	    system.tag.writeBlocking([tagPath], [False])
	    print("Tag deactivated.")
	
	# Main function
	def main():
	    # Activate the tag
	    activateTag()
	    
	    # Wait for 2 seconds
	    time.sleep(2)
	    
	    # Deactivate the tag
	    deactivateTag()
	
	# Run the main function
	main()
